formBuilder.title: Form Builder
formBuilder.subtitle: Event fields: {{eventName}}
formBuilder.templateOnlyEmpty: Apply a template only to an empty form.
formBuilder.moduleExists: There is already a {{name}} module in this form.
formBuilder.templatesHint: Creates the base sections and fields for the event type. You adjust everything later. Available only with an empty form.
formBuilder.emptyManual: Or create a section manually above.
formBuilder.columnsAria: Columns per row of the section
formBuilder.columnsTitle: How many fields per row in this section
formBuilder.modulePackageDesc: Module: Package — selection of products/batch with age-based pricing. The options come from the Products, Batches and Categories screens.
formBuilder.moduleRideDesc: Module: Ride — ride offer/request per registration (seats, contact and notes). The answers feed the Rides screen.
formBuilder.modulePositionNote: This section defines the position of the module in the form.
formBuilder.fieldKeyHelp: Used as the answer key. Unique per event.
formBuilder.sourceHelp: The options come automatically from the selected source and update themselves when you edit the event data.
formBuilder.consentTextPlaceholder: I declare that I have read and agree with...
formBuilder.deleteConfirmQuestion: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
formBuilder.deleteSectionSuffix: The section must have no fields.
formBuilder.deleteSectionAllSuffix: This will delete the section and all {{count}} field(s) inside it. This action cannot be undone.

minorTemplate.title: Template document for minors
minorTemplate.subtitle: Template file (e.g. consent/authorization) that guardians can download in the form. One per event.

formStage.title: Form Stage
formStage.subtitle: Current state of the registration form

form-on.label: Open
form-on.description: Registrations open — the form is available to everyone.

form-off.label: Closed
form-off.description: Shows the "registrations will open soon" screen.

form-waiting.label: Awaiting Start
form-waiting.description: Registrations closed — shows the camp waiting screen.

form-closed.label: Restricted
form-closed.description: Restricted access to the registration form.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Site under maintenance — unavailable to registrants.

formStage.modalBody: Change the form stage from {{from}} to {{to}}?

adminFields.title: Administrative fields
adminFields.subtitle: Fields filled in only by the admin — event: {{eventName}}
adminFields.hint: Extra columns in the registrants table that only the administration fills in after registration, separate from the public form.
adminFields.empty: No administrative fields registered. Create the first one above.
adminFields.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the field {{label}}? The values already filled in the registrations will be lost.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Event questions: {{eventName}}
faq.empty: No questions registered. Create the first one above.
faq.questionPlaceholder: E.g.: When and where will the event be?
faq.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the question {{question}}?

homeInfo.title: Form Initial Information
homeInfo.subtitle: Content shown on the form home page
homeInfo.iconTitleRequired: Fill in at least icon and title

title.label: Title:
title.placeholder: E.g.: Camp during the Carnival period 2000

subtitle.label: Subtitle:
subtitle.placeholder: E.g.: United by the word of Truth

locationAndDate.label: Location and Date:
locationAndDate.placeholder: E.g.: IP de Boa Viagem • Feb 01 to 04 • Garanhuns

homeInfo.baseInfoDesc: Main data shown at the top of the form home page.
homeInfo.deleteItemConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this item?
homeInfo.deleteAllConfirm: This action will remove all homepage information. Do you want to continue?

institutional.title: Institutional Area
institutional.subtitle: Configure the home page: texts, photos, team, schedule and notices. The registration button always leads to the form.
institutional.saveError: Could not save the institutional area.
institutional.colorHelp: Highlight color of the institutional page (independent of the form color).
institutional.visitsSwitch: Show the number of visits on the public page
institutional.albumLabel: Album (opens in the modal when clicked)

utility.title: Utility Settings
utility.subtitle: Contact, event date, boleto installments, map, social networks and more.
utility.contactHelp: Used wherever the organization contact is shown (WhatsApp, FAQ, waiting screens).
utility.spreadsheetHelp: The "Old Spreadsheet" button on the admin home. Blank = hidden.
utility.pagarmeHelp: Prefix of the "view order" link; the order number is appended at the end.
utility.eventDateHelp: Event start. Reference for calculating ages/packages and for the boleto installments.
utility.boletoMaxHelp: Cap on boleto installments, respecting the months until the event.
utility.boletoMinLabel: Last Boleto Due Date (days before the event)
utility.boletoMinHelp: Locks the last boleto due date to at least this margin (days) before the event. Blank uses the default.
utility.crewBusHelp: Total seats on the bus reserved for the crew.
utility.mapHelp: Shows a map of the location on the event home. Blank = hidden.
utility.whatsappHelp: The button and QR code only appear when this link is filled in.
utility.lgpdSwitch: Show the LGPD modal when opening the form
utility.lgpdHelp: When off, the LGPD compliance notice does not appear when the form opens.
utility.socialHelp: Each icon only appears in the footer when the link is filled in.
utility.templateHelp: PDF that the minor registrant downloads, signs and resubmits. Replace it here when the terms change.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Create and configure the events available for registration.
events.packageDisabledTitle: Enable payment to configure the package
events.contactHelp: Used everywhere the event organizer's contact is shown.
events.iconHelp: Choose an icon to appear on the event card on the home page. It takes the primary color.
events.imageSaveFirst: Save the event first to add an image to the card.
events.imageHelp: Appears at the top of the event card in the catalog. Leave without an image to use only the icon.
events.stageHelp: "Awaiting event": the card still appears, but the user only logs into the account, they no longer register.
events.contactMsgPlaceholder: Pre-filled message when opening the conversation (optional)
events.shareMsgPlaceholder: Text sent when sharing the event (optional)
events.deliveryNotePlaceholder: E.g.: items will be handed out at check-in (optional)
events.spreadsheetHelp: The "Old Spreadsheet" button on the admin home. Leave blank to hide.
events.faviconHelp: Browser tab icon on the event pages. Leave blank to use the default.
events.mapHelp: Shows a map of the location on the event home. Leave blank to hide.
events.groupDiscountHelp: When the order's package total reaches the minimum amount, it applies the discount percentage on the packages (not on the registration fee). Leave blank to disable.
events.socialHelp: Each icon only appears in the event footer when the link is filled in.
events.paymentHelp: If disabled, the form is submitted without a cart or charge.
events.feePassed: Pass to the registrant (added to the amount at checkout)
events.feeAbsorbed: Absorb (deducted from the amount I receive)
events.feeHelp: Defines whether the platform fee is added to what the registrant pays or deducted from the church's amount.
events.agePricingSwitch: Price by age (brackets configurable in the Package)
events.agePricingHelp: Adds a birth date field and age-based discount brackets.
events.regFeeHelp: Uses the active batch's registration fee, adding it to each registrant's package.
events.boletoHelp: Allows paying the registration in monthly boletos. The 1st boleto confirms the spot.
events.boletoMinLabel: Last boleto due date (days before the event)
events.boletoMinHelp: The last boleto is due at most this number of days before the event, ensuring the payment (which takes 2 to 5 business days to clear) arrives before the date. Blank uses the default (20 days).
events.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? Events with linked registrations cannot be deleted, deactivate it.
events.enableCouponsHelp: Lets the registrant apply a coupon code in the form. Manage the codes on the Coupons screen.
events.refundProtectionHelp: The registrant pays a protection fee in the form and can request the refund themselves from their account.
events.refundDeadlineLabel: Deadline to request refund (days before start)

orgBranding.title: Organization Identity
orgBranding.subtitle: Customize the home page your registrants see
orgBranding.logoDesc: Shown at the top of your public page. PNG or JPG, transparent background preferred.
orgBranding.descriptionDesc: A short sentence that introduces your organization to registrants.
orgBranding.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g.: Christian community in Barra da Tijuca. Register for our events.
orgBranding.colorDesc: Used in the highlights of the public page.
orgBranding.descFallback: Select an event below to start your registration
orgBranding.loadError: Could not load the organization identity.
orgBranding.colorInvalid: Enter a color in hexadecimal format, e.g.: #0ea5a0.
